title: Primary Data Classifications
description: Single primary sensitivity classification used by NEXT F privacy metadata.

classes.label: Public
classes.description: Information intentionally eligible for unauthenticated public delivery under its owning contract.

classes.label: Internal
classes.description: Operational or configuration information that is not public but is not inherently personal or secret.

classes.label: Personal
classes.description: Information relating to or reasonably linkable to a person, visitor, customer, lead or staff principal.

classes.label: Sensitive
classes.description: Higher-risk personal, financial, authentication, transaction or operational information requiring restricted handling.

classes.label: Secret
classes.description: Credentials, tokens, signing material, encryption keys or equivalent values that must not be disclosed through public/runtime data flows.
